en.title: Welcome
en.body: Your membership is ready. Welcome aboard.

zh-CN.title: 欢迎
zh-CN.body: 您的会员账户已准备就绪，欢迎加入。

en.title: Recharge confirmed
en.body: Recharge confirmed: {points} points.

zh-CN.title: 充值已确认
zh-CN.body: 充值已确认：{points} 积分。

en.title: Reward grant recorded
en.body: Historical record: {points} points were credited to your gift available balance. This records a past grant, not your current wallet balance or an external payment. Check your current wallet; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 奖励发放记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：{points} 积分曾记入赠送可用积分。此记录表示过去的发放，不代表当前钱包余额或外部付款。请查看当前钱包；此记录会保留。

en.title: Reward revocation pending recorded
en.body: Historical record: a full reward reversal of {points} points was requested and recorded as awaiting operator handling. No points moved in this attempt. It does not retry, unfreeze or deduct automatically; check the current wallet.

zh-CN.title: 奖励撤销待处理记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：曾申请全额撤销 {points} 积分奖励，并记录为待运营处理。本次没有积分变动，不会自动重试、解冻或扣除；请查看当前钱包。

en.title: Reward reversal recorded
en.body: Historical record: the full original reward of {points} points was reversed from your gift available balance. This records a past reversal, not your current wallet balance or an external payment. Check your current wallet; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 奖励撤销记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：原奖励全额 {points} 积分曾从赠送可用积分撤销。此记录表示过去的撤销，不代表当前钱包余额或外部付款。请查看当前钱包；此记录会保留。

en.title: Order submitted
en.body: Order submitted: {points} points.

zh-CN.title: 注单已提交
zh-CN.body: 注单已提交，涉及 {points} 积分。

en.title: Order cancelled
en.body: Cancelled. {points} points were returned to your original balance.

zh-CN.title: 注单已取消
zh-CN.body: 注单已取消，{points} 积分已原路退回。

en.title: Order cancelled after review
en.body: Cancelled after review. {points} points were returned to your original balance.

zh-CN.title: 注单已判定取消
zh-CN.body: 注单经判定已取消，{points} 积分已原路退回。

en.title: Order needs review
en.body: Your order needs manual review. Points involved: {points}.

zh-CN.title: 注单待人工处理
zh-CN.body: 您的注单需要人工处理，涉及积分：{points}。

en.title: Prize credit recorded
en.body: Historical record: {points} points were credited as this order's prize. This records the credit, not your current wallet balance or a guaranteed final outcome. Any correction will appear as a separate prize event; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 派奖入账记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：此注单的 {points} 积分奖金已记入账本。此记录仅表示该笔入账，不代表当前钱包余额，也不保证最终结果。任何更正都会作为单独的奖金事件记录；此记录会保留。

en.title: Prize reversal recorded
en.body: Historical record: the full original prize amount of {points} points for this order was reversed. This records the reversal, not your current wallet balance. Any later prize correction will appear as a separate event; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 奖金冲正记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：此注单原奖金全额 {points} 积分已冲回。此记录仅表示该笔冲正，不代表当前钱包余额。之后如有奖金更正，会作为单独事件记录；此记录会保留。

en.title: Commission credit recorded
en.body: Historical record: {points} points were credited to your commission wallet. This records a past credit, not new income or an external payment forecast. Check your current wallet balance; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 佣金入账记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：{points} 积分曾记入佣金钱包。此记录表示过去的入账，不是新收入预测或外部付款承诺。请查看当前钱包余额；此记录会保留。

en.title: Commission correction recorded
en.body: Historical record: a commission correction of {points} points was posted to your commission available balance. Positive points record a past additional credit; negative points record a past recovery. This is not your current balance, new income or an external payment. Check your current wallet; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 佣金更正记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：佣金可用积分曾发生 {points} 积分更正。正数表示过去的补发，负数表示过去的追回；不代表当前余额、新收入或外部付款。请查看当前钱包；此记录会保留。

en.title: Draw result published
en.body: Historical result ID {resource_id}: the result published for this period. This is not a guarantee of a win or prize payment. View the actual result in the app; users cannot edit this notice.

zh-CN.title: 开奖结果已公布
zh-CN.body: 历史开奖结果 ID：{resource_id}，表示本期已公布的结果，不代表中奖或派奖保证。请在应用中查看实际结果；用户不能编辑此通知。

en.title: Draw result corrected
en.body: Historical result ID {resource_id}: the corrected result for this period. This is not a guarantee of a win or prize payment. View the actual result in the app; users cannot edit this notice.

zh-CN.title: 开奖结果已更正
zh-CN.body: 历史开奖结果 ID：{resource_id}，表示本期已更正的结果，不代表中奖或派奖保证。请在应用中查看实际结果；用户不能编辑此通知。

en.title: Commission adjustment recorded
en.body: Historical record: a commission adjustment of {points} points was recorded. This records a past adjustment, not new income or an external payment forecast. Check your current wallet balance; this record is retained.

zh-CN.title: 佣金调整记录
zh-CN.body: 历史记录：曾调整 {points} 积分。此记录表示过去的调整，不是新收入预测或外部付款承诺。请查看当前钱包余额；此记录会保留。

en.title: Withdrawal status recorded
en.body: Historical withdrawal status: reviewing. Points involved: {points}. This is an internal points record, not proof of an external transfer. Check the withdrawal order for its current state.

zh-CN.title: 提现状态记录
zh-CN.body: 历史提现状态：审核中，涉及 {points} 积分。此为内部积分记录，不证明外部转账；请查询提现订单的最新状态。

en.title: Withdrawal status recorded
en.body: Historical withdrawal status: processing. Points involved: {points}. This is an internal points record, not proof of an external transfer. Check the withdrawal order for its current state.

zh-CN.title: 提现状态记录
zh-CN.body: 历史提现状态：提现中，涉及 {points} 积分。此为内部积分记录，不证明外部转账；请查询提现订单的最新状态。

en.title: Withdrawal status recorded

zh-CN.title: 提现状态记录
zh-CN.body: 历史提现状态：已提现，涉及 {points} 积分。此为内部积分记录，不证明外部转账；请查询提现订单的最新状态。

zh-CN.body: 历史提现状态：已驳回，涉及 {points} 积分。此为内部积分记录，不证明外部转账；请查询提现订单的最新状态。

en.body: Historical withdrawal status: cancelled. Points involved: {points}. This is an internal points record, not proof of an external transfer. Check the withdrawal order for its current state.

zh-CN.body: 历史提现状态：已取消，涉及 {points} 积分。此为内部积分记录，不证明外部转账；请查询提现订单的最新状态。
